scope: Hydraulic pressure and leakage testing of 1200 m of an explicitly selected PE100 SDR17 OD 250 PN10 pressure sewer pipeline split into four isolated test sections. Eight temporary PE250-PN10-TEST-CAP closures, calibrated gauges and recorder, hoses/manifold, fill water and approved disposal, test records, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved pipeline designer, pressure-test procedure author, calibrated-instrument provider, water supplier, disposal authority and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: pipe supply or laying, trench, bedding, backfill, manholes or commissioning beyond the selected pressure and leakage test
water, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from tested-length coefficients
automatic imported-water supply, treatment or off-site disposal
